limitation: Image-level bootstrap assumes independent images. Patient identifiers are unavailable, so fellow-eye dependence may make confidence intervals too narrow. The existing ODIR/retina overlap check detects identical files only, not resized or edited copies.

policy.threshold: Sensitivity >= 0.90 before uncertainty; fewest false positives; highest threshold breaks ties
policy.uncertainty: Distance band containing ceil(0.05*N) nearest scores, including ties
policy.calibration: Use exact reviewed Platt parameters for each checkpoint and head
policy.scope: All 12 head/seed pairs retained for reporting; shared seed 42 selected for the app before external testing

limitations: Validation selection results are not independent test estimates.
External sensitivity is not guaranteed to reach 90%.
Earlier single-model holdout observations exist and were not used to select these settings.
